college_identity.identity_notes: One of the 31 NITs, established 2010 under the NIT Act 2007. Currently operates from a temporary campus at Bijni Complex, Laitumkhrah, Shillong (on land associated with North Eastern Hill University), with hostels scattered across multiple separate locations in Shillong city (Lapalang, Kench's Trace, etc.), requiring institute-provided bus transport. A permanent campus (~300 acres, plus additional planned acreage) has been under construction at Sohra (Cherrapunjee), about 55km from Shillong, since the foundation stone was laid in 2012; multiple reviews describe an anticipated but repeatedly-delayed shift to this permanent site. Also known colloquially as 'NIT Shillong.' No naming conflicts with other distinct institutions were identified for this college, though one secondary source (CollegeDekho) was found to contain a factual error describing NIT Meghalaya as a 'private college' — this is incorrect (it is a public, centrally-funded government institution) and was excluded from this extraction as clearly erroneous.

limitations: Reddit: targeted searches for NIT Meghalaya/NITM specifically on Reddit did not surface genuine reddit.com-hosted threads in this session, despite an explicit dedicated search attempt; marked unavailable, no items fabricated.
Google Reviews/Maps: no tool access and no verifiable live aggregate found via search; marked unavailable, no items fabricated.

One secondary source (CollegeDekho) contained a factual error describing NIT Meghalaya as a 'private college' — this is incorrect, since it is a public, centrally-funded government institution under the NIT Act. This erroneous claim was identified and excluded from the extraction rather than propagated.

A recurring, well-corroborated theme across at least four independent sources (Shiksha x2, Collegedunia x2, Careers360) is the logistical burden of hostels being geographically scattered across Shillong city, separate from the temporary academic campus, requiring bus transport and adding meaningful daily commute time — this is presented as a structural characteristic rather than a subjective complaint from any single source.

Placement sentiment shows genuine year-to-year variation: some reviews describe very strong outcomes (100% placement rate, high packages), while at least one more recent-seeming review describes a multi-year placement downturn ('very average, or even below average, for the last two to three years') — both are preserved independently rather than reconciled.
The CollegeSearch aggregate (4.1/5) is based on only 7 verified reviews — an extremely small sample explicitly flagged for low confidence.

Aggregate ratings vary modestly across platforms (Shiksha 3.8/5, Careers360 4.0/5, CollegeSearch 4.1/5) but are broadly consistent with each other, unlike the wider divergence seen for some other institutions in this dataset (e.g., NIT Uttarakhand).
